title: P24.3M smuggled cigarettes seized in Negros warehouse raid
summary: MURCIA, Negros Occidental — A warehouse in Barangay Santa Rosa yielded more than P24.3 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes after law enforcement operatives raided the facility on Friday…

blocks.text: MURCIA, Negros Occidental — A warehouse in Barangay Santa Rosa yielded more than P24.3 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes after law enforcement operatives raided the facility on Friday morning, Nov. 27. Operatives seized 429 master cases of cigarettes during the operation in Purok Ipil-Ipil, following intelligence reports that illicit tobacco products were being stored
